narrative_goal: Show that from 2011 to 2015 the IRS budget, revenue agents, and audits per year all declined, with revenue agents falling from 13.5k to 10k and audits from 1.7M to 1.2M.
intent_en: Compare the trends in IRS budget, revenue agents, and audits per year from 2011 to 2015 to determine how each measure changed over that period.
